item.title: [7.4] ECB to lose Christine Lagarde. Where's she headed?
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The European Central Bank maintained interest rates, indicating rising inflation risks tied to increasing energy prices. Following the decision, the euro declined against the dollar and the pound, reaching a low not seen in 18 months. Euro zone bond yields also dropped slightly, while European stocks experienced a modest rise.

WHY IT MATTERS

The unexpected early departure of ECB President Christine Lagarde combined with active rate decisions and multi-month currency lows represents a major material change for European markets.

item.title: [6.8] Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a...

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper presents a theoretically grounded integration of deep reinforcement learning and mechanism design, solving a long-standing tension between strategyproofness and non-linear resource allocation.

item.description:
